title: State child-care payment reviews: San Francisco contractors
question: When the State sampled child-care cases for improper payments, how did San Francisco contractors do?
finding: The State's error-rate studies for 2021-22 and 2022-23 sampled 6 San Francisco contractor-years; 2 had errors. Highest: Felton Institute (2022-23, center-based), 25% of sampled cases in error, $7,185 of $29,070 sampled payments. Statewide rates: 2021-22 voucher 1.16%, centre 1.84%; 2022-23 voucher 2.91%, centre 5.19%.
how: Each report's appendix tables of contractors reviewed (county, agency, error rate, sampled payments, dollar errors) were read line by line; county names split over two lines are rejoined. Statewide rates are read from each report's summary.
limits: Samples are small (a few thousand to tens of thousands of dollars per contractor), so one case moves the rate a great deal. 'Improper payment' in the federal definition includes paperwork errors such as a missing need document, not only overpayment; the State reports no fraud finding against any contractor here.

sources.t: California Department of Social Services: Error Rates in Child Care and Development Programs, FY2021-22
